node.title: KoalaBear m2 r4 diagonal c2 (1,1,2) saturated-defect classifier
node.closure: exact one-unit defect ledger and finite edge-packet census for the saturated diagonal (1,1,2) cases
node.statement: In every saturated diagonal (1,1,2) packet, the reciprocal square vertices have weight exactly two and consume two of the three source-defect units. The remaining common-K stars are four J_0-J_0 and four J_0-J_1 edges, with each J_1 degree two beyond the square and at most one repeated edge. The J_0 profiles are exactly (2,2,4,4), (2,3,3,4), and (3,3,3,3). There are 1560 labeled packets in 123 matching-preserving orbits; source-line star equivariance leaves 96 labeled packets in 12 orbits. These are attack lists, not realized components or a row deletion.
